text: Black Kite Re Limited (Series 2025‑1) is a catastrophe bond issuance by Peak Reinsurance Company, utilizing a Hong Kong-domiciled special purpose insurer, Black Kite Re Limited. The bond provides multi-peril, multi-territory retrocessional reinsurance to Peak Re over a three-year term, with a focus on parametric earthquake protection for Mainland China. This initiative aims to mobilize capital markets to address Asia's protection gap, particularly in seismic risk areas.
